title: JSON Search
subtitle: Can a GPU search a hundred thousand JSON documents faster, one thread each, with the lab's own weighted-sum program?

chapters.title: One Thread Per Document
chapters.blurb: One program, 100,000 generated JSON documents, and a GPU thread for each, checked against the CPU.

chapters.title: Search Is a Matrix Product
chapters.blurb: The pattern is data, and each code point multiplies a zero-one state vector by a transition matrix, once backward and once forward.

chapters.title: Packing the Bits
chapters.blurb: The same search program went from 945 milliseconds to 5.24 at 32 states once its shader packed states into 32-bit words.

chapters.title: Who Does It Beat
chapters.blurb: The same GPU search races the CPU, RegExp and worker threads; the lab's own status says where it wins, loses and is still open.
